we have found that Web retail service quality does have a positive impact on consumer perceptions of product categories and willingness to buy and that product categories do moderate the relationship between Web retail service quality perceptions and perceived product quality, perceptions of value, and willingness-to-buy.

the effects of Web retail service are not the same for all products, and this has important implications for marketing managers.
